scope: Read-only public-source feasibility review. No external installation, adoption, port or new geometry experiment.
assessment_kind: Source capabilities are verified; applicability, cost and priority are engineering judgments, not tested CHESHIRE results.

shortlist.borrow: Keep named cap descendants eligible for the next inset/extrusion; retain walls and root as separate roles.

source_verified.capability: Relative inset toward parent face center, retained cap, attached sidewall ring and named output selections.
Register subdivided child faces as derived from the selected actual parent face.
Propagate named selection membership to derived faces.

shortlist.local_gap: Task32 already constructs cap/wall topology and stores parent_event/parent_face associations. Late MIDDLE/LINKED/WIDE fields do not use persistent cap/wall roles to schedule the next ornament. Borrow organization, not a replacement mesh kernel.
shortlist.proposed_sequence_only: Tag parent cap patch -> relative inset/extrusion -> subdivision -> reselect only cap descendants for the next ornament.
shortlist.cost_assessment: Low-to-medium for role scheduling on existing coarse ancestry arrays; high and unjustified for migrating 7M controls into a Java object-mesh library.
shortlist.limits: Relative inset shrinks footprint, but extrusion height is independently supplied. Named membership is not a complete parent-ID genealogy. No collision, visual hierarchy or ornament-quality guarantee.
shortlist.license: Inspected HEM_Extrude/HES_QuadSplit/HE_Mesh headers and README: CC0/Public Domain; other enumerated files and external packages have separate terms.

shortlist.priority: Conditional: constrained directions at turns and junctions
shortlist.borrow: Solve a smooth tangent line field constrained by actual parent-fold tangents, rather than introducing another independent global phase.

source_verified.capability: N-RoSy field with supplied tangent-space constraints and hard or soft alignment weights; N=2 is a line field.
Tangent-space connections, smoothness matrices and constrained sparse solve.

shortlist.local_gap: Existing inherited scalar phase and intrinsic gradient already provide direction in ordinary parent regions. The added value is reconciling several parent-direction constraints around transition/junction regions.
shortlist.cost_assessment: Medium: C++/Eigen solver and correspondence between a smaller carrier field and current dense controls. Dense G7 global solve is not recommended without measured need.
shortlist.limits: Field-only evaluation need not change current IDs. Full setup_integration cuts the mesh and duplicates vertices, so it would require new V/E/F and mirror correspondence management. Does not generate ornament, enforce parent scale or guarantee aesthetics.
shortlist.license: MPL-2.0 in the inspected source headers.

deferred.verified: tessellate_patch maps component UV coordinates to actual surface patches, interpolates weights and repeats generated geometry as the next base. Optional adjacent-boundary merging exists.
deferred.judgment: Useful only if a well-shaped small fold/leaf component is already designed and needs controlled surface attachment. Whole-face repeated component placement does not itself establish parent hierarchy and may reintroduce tiled or attached decoration. Not a current priority.

deferred.verified: Selected-face adaptive refinement and patch tables with base-face/UV correspondence.
deferred.judgment: Potential future memory/resolution optimization. Does not create hierarchical ornament or automatically reproduce CHESHIRE custom directional subdivision. Output IDs differ; currently not worth replacing the pipeline.

deferred.verified: insetN constructs inset caps and sidewalls with global popout and polygon-degree selection.
deferred.judgment: Largely duplicates existing Task32 geometry and lacks the persistent role/descendant schedule sought here. No adoption value for this cycle.

current_geometry_checkpoint: parent_nested_folds_20261014/trial02 was generated before this external-source research and does not use either shortlisted external technique.
